Metadata.description: Church management platform with presentation tools for weekly worship.

Home.title: Prepare Sunday worship slides in minutes
Home.lead: Build each week's presentation from a reusable liturgy template instead of starting from a blank file.

templates.title: Liturgy templates
templates.body: Set the order of worship once and reuse it every week.

library.title: Songs and scripture
library.body: Pick a hymn or a passage and its slides are filled in for you.

present.title: Present and export
present.body: Run the slideshow full screen or download it as a PDF.
